pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal geometries with varying spatial area; larger, more angular patches occupy the mid-flank, transitioning into smaller, more rounded and densely tessellated regions toward the posterior and ventral areas. Edges show moderately defined pixel gradients.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored negative space featuring frequent tri-axial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways remains relatively uniform across the mid-flank, narrowing between smaller posterior patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short, dark-colored mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette along the cervical dorsal line and shoulder transition.

other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, dark avian organisms (oxpeckers) are visible clinging to the lateral neck surface and the dorsal ridge.
